question: Who was the father of Baji Rao I?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Peshwa Balaji Vishwanath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Peshwa Balaji Vishwanath** was the father of **Baji Rao I**, who served as the Peshwa (Prime Minister) of the Maratha Empire under Chhatrapati Shahu.
 
• Balaji Vishwanath was the first Peshwa to gain significant political influence and laid the foundation for the hereditary Peshwa system in the Maratha Empire.
 
• Baji Rao I, born on **18 August 1700**, succeeded his father Balaji Vishwanath as Peshwa in **1720** and became one of the most notable military leaders in Indian history.
 
• Balaji Vishwanath played a key role in stabilizing the Maratha Empire during turbulent times and strengthened the position of the Peshwas, which allowed Baji Rao I to expand the empire further.
 
• Balaji Vishwanath was instrumental in signing the **Treaty of Delhi (1719)**, which granted significant rights to the Maratha
